description: Five channels that generate a gate with shaped edges whenever their input rises above a threshold, plus combined AND and OR gates

params.text: Sets the length of that channel's gate in samples; 4410 samples is 100ms at a 44.1kHz sample rate
Sets the length of the slope at each edge of that channel's gate, which turns the gate into a small envelope
Shapes the slopes of that channel's gate: linear at 0V, towards exponential at -1V and towards logarithmic at 1V
Sets the voltage a channel input must rise above for gates to be generated, 0.1 volts by default
Sets the voltage of the generated gates, which is added to the offset; a negative level with a positive offset gives inverted gates
Offsets the voltage of the generated gates, on top of the level

inputs.text: The signal for that channel, which generates a gate while it is above the threshold; with nothing patched the channel takes the signal of the channel above it
A signal above 0V ends the gate that channel is generating, and the gate then follows its end slope
Modulates the length of that channel's gate
Modulates the slope length of that channel's gate
Modulates the slope shape of that channel's gate
Modulates the threshold voltage the channel inputs are measured against
Modulates the level of the generated gates
Modulates the offset applied to the generated gates

outputs.text: The gate generated by that channel, at the level and offset set, with its slopes on each edge
A gate while at least one channel has an active gate, with no slopes on its edges
A gate while every channel has an active gate, with no slopes on its edges

notes: a gate covers its start slope but not its end slope, so a channel is busy for the gate length plus one slope length
when a gate ends while its input is above the threshold, the next gate begins immediately
a channel generates nothing until a signal patched into it rises above the threshold; with only channel A patched, every channel below it takes that same signal
menu: CV Param Mode sets how every CV input acts on its knob: Offset adds the CV to it, Follow sets it from the CV, Attenuate scales the CV by it
CV Input Slew smooths every CV input, which stops abrupt CV changes clicking: None, 1ms, 5ms, 10ms, 25ms, 50ms or 100ms
Clamp CV Values keeps a value driven by CV inside the range of its knob; switched off, the value can go past that range
